_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. A mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so the oracle registration and the catalog live here rather than in a shared manifest. `en1997-1-any` is generated from each triad leaf's own `SemanticDescriptor.kind`, in `#[derive(dsl::Mutations)]`'s declaration order, and `kinds_match_the_enum_and_the_catalog` in `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🦀️.rs` fails the moment this list and the enum part company.

oracles.rationale:
🐍️ No third-party library in any ecosystem reads or writes `s.norm.en1997` — checked against PyPI, which serves no `en1997`, `eurocode`, `vdi3805` or `iso16757` distribution, and whose nearest real packages (`structuralcodes`, `concreteproperties`, `anastruct`) implement design-code formulae and speak no interchange format — so this subset's reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION rather than a third-party distribution. That is why `package` is empty: the entry links no external library and contributes nothing to the dependency ratchet. The implementation is the shared norm reference engine `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️execution/🐍️.py` fed by `../🧪️tests/🌍️mutate-en1997-1/🐍️.py`, all 20 kinds of `En1998Mutation` written in Python from `26/08/12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL`'s `📓️taxonomy.md` (verb table, the `new_<field>` naming mechanic, the addressing convention) and `📓️derivation-rules.md` (shape rules), plus this manifest's own catalog for the closed list of kinds. It imports nothing from the Rust it judges and transliterates none of it — the field a `new*` argument names is resolved by normalised spelling against the document's own keys, exactly as the naming mechanic states. Its reading is pinned by reaching every committed handcrafted `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` vector and by re-emitting the committed `.dsl.semio` artifact byte for byte, neither of which a misreading could do.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `en1997-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 20-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.

[2026-09-02, D1 — SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION] Promoted from cross-semio-implementation to verified-native-second-implementation: this artifact is semio-native (isSemioNativeArtifact), this reference's own third-party survey above (kept verbatim) already names what was checked and declined, its python implementation differs from the Rust subject, and it covers 100% of this manifest's 1 capability/capabilities with 23 committed fixture vector(s). oracles.rationale: 🐍️ Independent-formulation compliance oracle of EN1997: the python compliance script recomputes the Rust check chain and the shared harness (`✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness`) replays blessed oracle cases against the third-party references claimed in the norm root registry (`norm-eurocode-structuralcodes`, `-concreteproperties`, `-sectionproperties`, `-blue-prints`, `-sympy`, `-groundhog`, scipy numerics). Labelled honestly as independent formulation, not third-party validation, wherever no library covers the clause. Wave 2 doc oracles v2: the document-level oracle `🚦️check-outcome/🐍️.py` evaluates a snapshot through the compliance oracle's stdlib library of EN 1997-1 Annex D, DIN 4017 and DIN 4085 (bearing, sliding, eccentricity, settlement and pair distortion and tilt, piles, anchors, retaining walls, slope stability, uplift, hydraulic failure, investigation) and its `--self-check` validates N_q, N_gamma (against the Vesic factor of groundhog) and the Boussinesq stress under a rectangle against groundhog 0.15 (the plotting packages groundhog imports at module level are stubbed).

Reference values of the EN1997 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1997.8.anchor-elongation are computed by anastruct 1.7.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/anastruct/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

Reference values of the EN1997 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1997.2.cpt-behaviour-index, en1997.2.cpt-friction-angle, en1997.2.cpt-undrained-strength, en1997.2.phase-relations, en1997.9.earth-pressure, en1997.9.embedded-wall, en1997.D.4.bearing-factors, en1997.D.4.bearing-resistance, en1997.F.boussinesq, en1997.F.oedometer-settlement, en1997.F.stress-strain-settlement are computed by groundhog 0.15.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/groundhog/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

Independent formulations (numerical integration, root finding, eigenproblems and closed-form derivations that never reuse the rust expression) of the EN1997 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1997.7.pile-group, en1997.7.pile-resistance, en1997.8.anchor-elongation, en1997.8.anchor-resistance, en1997.9.embedded-wall, en1997.D.4.bearing-resistance, en1997.F.boussinesq, en1997.F.oedometer-settlement, en1997.F.stress-strain-settlement are computed by scipy 1.18.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/numerical/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

engine.implementation: SciPy quadrature, root finding, constrained minimisation and generalized eigenproblems on NumPy

oracles.rationale: Reference values of the design-case geotechnics case file `🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🌍️geotechnics/🔣️.json` (checks en1997.G.bearing-design, en1997.G.wall-sliding-design, en1997.G.settlement-primary, en1997.G.slope-bishop): Nq and the Vesic N_gamma (corrected to Annex D.4) and the Rankine coefficient and the normally-consolidated settlement of groundhog 0.15.0, the Boussinesq stress by scipy 1.18.0 double quadrature and the simplified Bishop factor by a numpy 400-slice scipy `brentq` root. The oracle `🔮️oracles/🌍️geotechnics/🐍️.py` reads the partial factors from the shared NDP registry rows (`ndp.en1997.*`, all unverified) of the case's annex, design approach and situation, never from the case; the Rust subject reads the same rows through the catalogue entries GEO-F01, RW-06, SLS-02 and SLOPE-01. Values are blessed from the libraries (`--bless`), never from the Rust. The factors are not National Annex values until the registry rows are verified.

Reference values of the EN1997 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1997.8.anchor-elongation are computed by PyNiteFEA 3.0.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/pynite/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

Reference values of the EN1997 oracle case files (`🧪️tests/🧫️fixtures/🔮️oracle-cases/third-party*.json`) for the checks en1997.7.pile-group, en1997.9.embedded-wall, en1997.D.4.bearing-resistance are computed by sympy 1.14.0. The harness adapter `✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🔮️oracles/🏃️harness/🔌️adapters/sympy/🐍️.py` is the only importer; values are blessed from the library, never from the Rust. National Annex parameters are inputs of the cases.

🐍️ Independent formulation of the EN 1997-2 Annex D ground derivation (GI-03 c_u from CPT readings with sigma_v0 by numeric stress integration, the EN 1997-1 2.4.5.2 statistical characteristic value with the Student-t factor, GI-07 phi' from SPT). The Student-t quantile is scipy.stats.t.ppf (the registry entry `en1997-1-scipy` covers that library); the formulation is otherwise independent of the Rust kernel `⚖️checks/🎯️ground-derivation`. Reference values are blessed from this oracle only, never from the Rust. The cone factor N_kt is read from the registry row ndp.en1997.2.cpt-nkt, which is unverified. The samples of the statistics are the independent values per investigation point (registry row ndp.en1997.2.characteristic-samples-per-sounding, unverified), not the autocorrelated readings.
